_sources.default_workers: PROPOSED: one report cut 15 agents to 3; the setups that lasted had about 4 worktrees. Not a proven limit.
_sources.max_godot_instances: Measured on a 32 GB machine at about 220 MB per headless game. Measure your own machine.
_sources.godot_slots_path: Shared by the kit skills; format in references/files.md
_sources.lane_root: work/ is gitignored, so it is not in a worktree. Resolve to the absolute path of <main>/work at run time
_sources.smoke_cmd: Your repo's smoke test: headless start, fixed checks, non-zero exit on failure
_sources.foreign_lanes: Map of lane name to globs that agents outside the manager own. Example: {"editor": ["scripts/editor*", "data/placements.json"]}
_sources.reply_max_lines: RUSuper manager: 3-4 lines to the human
_sources.banned_reply_words: No process words, no time estimates

worker_model.default: PROPOSED: a mid-size model for code lanes, the strongest model for look lanes
